'''2016 EGP Day 2 Barry Alperstein LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Barry Alperstein]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
